title: Senior Manager, Partner Strategy & Ops

Sr. Manager, Partner Strategy and Programs

The HubSpot Partner Strategy and Operations team is looking for a Senior Manager to lead our Partner Strategy and Programs function. Partners are critical to HubSpot's growth, helping millions of customers grow better. We are seeking a results-driven leader with a strong track record in SaaS GTM strategy and program execution.

As HubSpot shapes how businesses achieve new customer outcomes through agents, workflows, and automation, our partner ecosystem is central to delivering on that promise. This role is pivotal in building the programming, incentives, and frameworks that position partners to drive those outcomes - elevating their capabilities and ensuring they are equipped to grow alongside HubSpot in an AI-first world.

Strategy and Leadership

• Lead a high performing team responsible for developing and executing partner strategy and programs across key pillars: partner tiering, program benefits (commissions, incentives, funding initiatives), program requirements, and sales driven initiatives.

• Serve as a key strategy and operations business partner to Global Partner Development, Partner Specialist, Sales Operations, Finance, and Customer Success teams to ensure GTM alignment and execution.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration, building champions in other orgs for mutual success.

Program Management

• Build and evolve programming that positions partners to deliver the next generation of customer outcomes - through agents, workflows, and automation - with incentive structures and enablement that elevate partner performance and reward those leading in an AI-first world.

• Define and track KPIs such as MRR, partner activation rates, and pipeline velocity to ensure programs drive measurable revenue impact.

• 2+ years of experience leading or managing Senior or Principal-level ICs, with a proven track record of coaching high performers, growing teams, and elevating output - not just overseeing it.

• True player/coach mentality: comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close to the work and contributing directly on the highest-priority initiatives.

title: Research Engineer - Web Crawlers
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

- Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently.

- Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling.

- Designing targeted crawling pipelines that find high-value data sources, including audio, video, and multilingual content, and turn them into clean training-ready datasets.

- Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably.

 

REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

- Hands-on experience building and scaling web crawlers or scraping system

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Muris is building the AI operating system for agricultural logistics, optimizing the process from field to factory. Our food supply chains are increasingly exposed to fluctuations, caused by factors such as weather, prices, and labor shortages. We are working to make our food supply chains more sustainable, resilient, and future-ready.
You are the first technical hire. Your job is to turn messy operations into a decidable problem and ship the result so that dispatchers actually use it. Everything in between is yours: data, model, system, interface.
What you do

Formalize dispatching problems: what is being decided, at what granularity, under which assumptions, against which objectives.
Choose the simplest model that carries the decision. Heuristic before solver, solver before learning.
Define the evaluation before you build. What would a better decision have been, and how would we know.
Ship end-to-end: from the data pipeline through the model to the interface the dispatcher looks at. A recommendation nobody understands doesn't count.

This is not for you if

you're looking for a narrowly scoped specialist role
you want to solve open research questions
you want to fit a given dataset instead of formulating the problem yourself
you're not willing to visit our customers at the factories

This is for you if

you've turned messy reality into a decision problem before (OR, dispatch, planning, pricing, allocation)
you've built and operated production systems that people depend on
you're quantitatively strong and still prefer owning the whole over owning the method
you can explain models without hiding behind the method
you can work with incomplete data and hard constraints

We work in English. German is a big plus. Polish or Ukrainian helps to

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
At Gradient Labs , we're building the AI customer operations platform for financial services.
Founded in 2023, we now work with some of the biggest names in banking and fintech. Our platform runs specialist agents, purpose-built for financial services, to eliminate manual work across customer support and back-office operations. Together, they give product and operations teams the visibility and control to trust every outcome.
We're a team of builders from companies like Monzo, Wise, Revolut and Google. If you're excited to tackle some of the hardest problems in AI and help shape the future of customer operations, we'd love to hear from you.
🎯 How you’ll make an impact
This isn't a maintenance role or a feature factory. At Gradient Labs , you will own systems that matter - from the first architectural decision through to production, scale, and everything that breaks along the way.
You'll work on the infrastructure that makes autonomous AI agents actually reliable in the real world. That means building for failure, designing for observability, and shipping with conviction - not waiting for a perfect spec that will never arrive.

• Build the OS for AI Agents - Contribute to a safe, scalable platform that lets us iterate on autonomous agent capabilities faster than anyone else. You are building the infrastructure that makes AI actually work in production.

• Ship Resilient Systems - Design and own systems that hold up under failures, retry storms, and resource starvation - with full observability baked in. Reliability is a baseline, not an aspiration.

• Take Products from 0 → 1 → Scale - Scope something from scratch, make the early architectural calls, and stay responsible for it as it grows. We build with conviction and we see things through.

• Move Fast, Ship Often - Iterate in small increments. Multiple deploys a day. Comfort with ambiguity is not optional - it is the job. The mission moves faster than the roadmap.

💡 What you’ll bring

• Substantial tenure building production software at a fast-growing company - fintech, AI, consumer tech, or any environment where pace and stakes were both high

• Proven experience owning complex, high-stakes systems end to end - not handing off at merge, but staying accountable through observability, iteration, and scale

• Deep fluency in Go (Golang) and comfort operating across a modern backend stack (PostgreSQL, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes)

• A product instinct that goes beyond technical elegance - you think from the customer backwards and bring that into every architectural decision

• Senior, Staff, Principal or Distinguished level in practice - someone who has operated with real scope and real accountability

• Genuine excitement for autonomous AI as a platform shift, not a trend - you want to build the infrastructure that makes agents genuinely reliable

• Strong opinions, loosely held - conviction without ego, and always willing to be wrong in pursuit of the right answer

Why join Gradient Labs ?
This is a unique chance to be part of a team working with cutting-edge technology to reshape how businesses will operate in the future. Over the next 10 years, every company will need to embrace AI-powered operations to stay competitive, and this role puts you right in the middle of that transformation.
You’ll tackle challenging and new problems, work with some of the most exciting brands across different industries, and be surrounded by a passionate, smart team that’s driven to build something groundbreaking.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Efficiency
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake’s cloud spend is in billions of dollars per year. Hence, it is critical for us to govern and optimize our cloud spend, both for margins and long-term competitive advantage. Cloud Efficiency team’s charter is to build scalable products that enable governance, monitoring and optimization of cloud spend. Think of this as Observability for cloud costs and efficiency. The team’s vision is to “Transform cloud spend into a competitive advantage by empowering teams to continuously optimize the per-unit cost.”

 

In order to improve the overall cloud efficiency (i.e. cost per unit), it is critical to build monitoring products that collate costs with other factors such as utilization, attribution, hardware performance and architecture. Hence, there is an opportunity to build a unified, self-serve cloud efficiency product across Snowflake, that delivers actionable, real-time efficiency datasets through streamlined user experiences. This will enable thousands of engineers at Snowflake and will elevate cloud efficiency at Snowflake for long-term success.

 

When developing these solutions, we think about the problem end-to-end: how do we collect data from different stacks (e.g. costs from AWS, GCP, Azure and CPU, Memory, Utilization) across Snowflake reliably, how do we store it efficiently, how do we present this information to the user, what actions do we take on the insights from the data? What AI skills and agents we need to develop to enable quick and accurate cost analysis and identifying insights?

We are actively looking for a senior software engineer. If you love solving problems at scale, prefer to write scalable, reliable, and testable software, are an ace troubleshooter, and are deeply technical, then this is the role for you! Snowflake’s target of landing on the S&P 500 in combination with our rapidly growing portfolio in a highly innovative space demands more engineering maturity in the above. While these four domains describe the shape of our current goals, the engineer would be expected to drive the strategy and deliverables for clear company impact.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable monitoring solutions for cloud cost and efficiency

- Build tools and automation to enhance system monitoring, alerting, and root cause analysis.

- Improve and optimize data ingestion, storage, and query efficiency for monitoring cloud efficiency data at scale.

- Collaborate with teams across Snowflake to understand monitoring needs and implement solutions that improve operational visibility.

- Contribute to open-source and industry best practices in monitoring and distributed systems monitoring.

- Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of monitoring systems by participating in on-call rotations and incident management.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR:

- 7+ years of industry experience designing, building and supporting large scale systems in production.

- Experience with cost optimization and efficiency work on systems built on large private clouds or public cloud providers

- Deep system and architectural analysis experience to identify actionable performance and efficiency insights

- History of delivering large cross functional projects with measurable impact

- Proficiency

title: Operational Risk Senior Specialist
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Operational Risk Specialist, plays a vital role within the operational risk management function at Nu Mexico. The main duties involve identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating operational risks that may hinder the company from reaching its objectives. This is accomplished by developing methodologies and ensuring their implementation and execution within the first line of defense. This process includes training, review and challenge, monitoring key risk indicators, and escalating issues in appropriate Risk Forums. This role involves close collaboration with different departments and teams to execute various Operational Risk programs aimed at reducing and controlling the likelihood and impact of adverse operational risk events.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

1. Lead the oversight and continuous improvement of the Op Risk Management System, ensuring that policies, methodologies, procedures, governance practices, and supporting documentation remain aligned with local regulation and global standards.

2. Lead and coordinate the annual and continuous RCSA process, maintaining high-quality risk and control matrices by ensuring that operational risks are properly identified, documented, classified, assigned to processes and business lines, and linked to accountable owners and controls.

3. Perform independent 2LoD review and challenge of 1LoD risk assessments and controls, including the evaluation of inherent risk, residual risk, control design, control execution, supporting evidence, and overall control effectiveness.

4. Own the governance and periodic maintenance of risk matrices across macroprocesses, ensuring that changes in products, processes, regulations, systems, incidents, control gaps, and organizational priorities are properly reflected, documented, and traceable in the institutional risk inventory.

5. Assess complex operational risks and define appropriate treatment strategies based on inherent and residual risk exposure, risk appetite, and tolerance thresholds, including mitigation plans, risk transfers, formal risk acceptances, and escalation of risks outside tolerance.

6. Monitor operational loss events, incidents, and control gaps; lead or support root cause analysis; ensure accurate and timely registration; and define corrective, preventive, and improvement actions to reduce the likelihood of recurrence.

7. Design, manage, and enhance the Key Risk Indicator program for priority operational risks, ensuring that each applicable risk in the RCM has measurable indicators, defined amber and red thresholds, reliable data sources, periodic monitoring, documented analysis, and appropriate escalation.

8. Evaluate operational risks associated with new products, features, processes, operational changes, and other initiatives, ensuring that potential control gaps are identified, mitigation plans are defined, and required actions are completed before launch or formal implementation.

9. Prepare and present accurate, well-structured risk reports, dashboards, and management materials for senior leadership, the Non-Financial Risk Technical Forum, the Risk Committee, and other governance bodies

title: Marketing Assistant (Brand & Organic Marketing)
description:
Description
TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.
About the role

﻿
Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.
You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.
What you will do

• Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.

• Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages-a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.

• Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.

• The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.

• The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

• Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.

• Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.

• A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.

• B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.

• Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

• Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.

• Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

• Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).

• Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.

• Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.

• A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

title: Senior Oracle EBS Developer / Integration Architect
description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.
We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.
CompassX is partnering with an enterprise client to support a fast-moving AI-driven initiative connecting their Oracle E-Business Suite environment to a broader integration and applications ecosystem. This is a chance to work at the architecture and development level on a genuinely complex problem for an organization that's investing seriously in modernizing how its core ERP talks to the rest of its new applications and technology stack.
What You'll Do

• Design and build a common data-services layer that connects multiple, differently-configured Oracle EBS instances across regions - reconciling real differences between environments rather than treating them as identical

• Expose EBS data through integrations and APIs to other systems, with a particular focus on Manufacturing, Inventory, and Item Master data

• Work hands-on with PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces, and standard APIs - this is a build role, not a configuration role

• Partner directly with other developers and technical stakeholders as a peer - you'll be the one they come to with questions about the SQL and architecture, not someone translating between business and engineering

• Bring an architect's perspective to the work: looking across distinct systems, spotting where approaches diverge, and designing a solution that holds up across all of them rather than solving for just one environment

• Act as a trusted technical voice in a still-evolving initiative - this program is actively taking shape, and there's real room to help define how the work gets scoped and delivered, not just execute against a fixed spec

What You'll Bring

• Strong experience working as a true consultant to your stakeholders and clients

• Deep, hands-on Oracle EBS technical development experience - strong PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces and standard APIs, and concurrent program load mechanisms

• Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and/or SOA, plus REST/SOAP web services

• Working knowledge of EBS data models for Manufacturing/BOM, Inventory, and Item Master - direct experience with the Item/PTM table is especially valuable

• Experience working across multiple EBS instances, ideally having reconciled differently-configured environments

• A technical/integration mindset over a functional/configuration one - comfortable going deep on code and architecture, not just gathering requirements

• Comfort operating with some ambiguity - this is an early-stage initiative, and part of the value you bring is helping shape the approach alongside the team, not just following one that's already fully defined

• Bonus if familiarity with Oracle PD Cloud (Oracle PLM)

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.
At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

The Project Coordinator supports project execution, documentation accuracy, and cross‑functional alignment within Sabre’s federated operating model. This role ensures project information, procurement activities, documentation workflows, and client communications remain tightly coordinated at the business‑unit level while leveraging centralized functions (Finance, HR, Application Solutions & Commercial, IT/Digital) for shared governance and efficiency.

The Project Coordinator works closely with Project Managers, production teams, engineering, procurement, and document control to maintain project momentum, uphold compliance requirements, and ensure customer‑facing execution remains close to the site. This role is accountable for documentation quality, procurement tracking, communication flow, and project support activities that enable successful delivery of industrial electrical projects.

What You’ll Do

• Support RFQ reviews, scope validation, and supplier pricing/lead‑time gathering.

• Review customer POs and change orders for alignment with Sabre’s quoted scope.

• Prepare project documentation (schedules, RFIs, CORs, ITPs, FAT plans, meeting minutes).

• Assist with procurement: vendor coordination, PO issuance, pricing follow‑ups, tracking reports.

• Coordinate document control tasks (transmittals, FTP uploads, traveler docs, turnover packages).

• Support production floor activities, inventory coordination, and rental equipment needs.

• Assist with drawing/spec reviews and BOM checks during design stages.

• Maintain client communication when delegated by the Project Manager.

• Track invoicing milestones, prepare final invoices, and complete close‑out reports.

• Conduct weekly floor walks and support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with QMS, HSE, and Sabre standards.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of leadership or coordination experience in manufacturing or field construction.

• Strong communication, organization, and multitasking skills.

• Proficiency in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat; AutoCAD experience preferred.

• Experience in industrial electrical, instrumentation, high‑voltage switchgear, or E‑house construction is an asset.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates with a high degree of autonomy. You'll frequently be handed an ambiguous, technically complex problem - sometimes deep in areas like safety and cyber - with a tight timeline and no existing playbook, and be expected to shape the story, build the plan, and ship. • Skilled cross-functional collaborator who can align product, research, comms, and sales partners without formal authority

• Thrive in fast-moving, high-pressure environments where priorities shift and the playbook hasn't been written yet

Preferred Requirements

• 10+ years of product marketing experience in B2B or enterprise software, with a track record as a senior individual contributor

title: Intern Brand Marketing (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

As the Raisin Brand Team , we shape how people across Europe and the US save, invest, and manage their financial futures. Operating at the intersection of creative storytelling, data-driven insights, and strategic media buying, we act as a key driver of growth for our platform. Partnering closely with Design, Product, Content, Comms, and Performance Marketing, we ensure our brand guidelines are executed consistently across every touchpoint. In short: we build a trusted financial brand that customers love.

Your Responsibilities

• Sponsorships & Partner Management: Actively support the operational execution and management of our sponsorship projects (such as our partnership with 1. FC Union Berlin) and liaise with external partners.

• Day-to-Day Brand Management: Gain hands-on experience in core brand management tasks, helping to ensure our Brand Guidelines are consistently applied across all communication channels.

• Creative Project Work: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Design, Content, Communications) and contribute your ideas to overarching brand marketing campaigns.

• Social Media & Brand Alignment: Assist with day-to-day social media operations (e.g., editorial planning and community management), ensuring that all social media activities and visual assets strictly align with our Brand Guidelines.

Your Profile

• Academic Background: You are currently enrolled in or recently graduated with a degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Media Management., or a related field.

• Location: You are based in Berlin/Brandenburg.

• Language Proficiency: You have excellent communication skills in both German (C1 level or higher, essential for handling local partner communications, e.g., for sponsorships) and English (our official company language). Additional skills in Spanish, Italian, French, Polish, or Dutch are a plus.

• Drive & Curiosity: Extensive prior experience in Brand Marketing is not required. What matters most to us is your genuine enthusiasm for the financial industry, brand strategy, and bringing brand partnerships to life.

• Structured Mindset & Tech-Savviness: You bring strong organizational and project management skills (or a natural talent for keeping projects on track), and you are excited about leveraging AI tools to work smarter and optimize your daily tasks.

Join our mission, join our team - and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:
Employee Development Budget of €400 and one full training day per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 20 vacation days per year.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
